select coalesce(series_ticker,'?') s, count(*) mkts, round(sum(period_reward_usd)::numeric,0) reward_usd,
 round(avg(extract(epoch from (end_date-start_date))/86400)::numeric,1) avg_days,
 round(sum(period_reward_usd/greatest(extract(epoch from (end_date-start_date))/86400,1))::numeric,0) usd_per_day
from incentive_programs where superseded_at is null and disappeared_at is null and incentive_type='liquidity' and end_date>now()
group by 1 order by usd_per_day desc nulls last limit 40
